about.title: About Me
bio: Full-stack developer with a unique foundation in mathematics, cryptography, and logic — skills that turn complex problems into clean, scalable code. Self-taught and relentlessly curious, I bridge creative front-end design and robust back-end architecture.

Frontend: React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript and TailwindCSS. Backend: Node.js, Express and NestJS — modular, type-safe REST APIs with JWT authentication, role-based permissions and Swagger docs. Data: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM, MongoDB, and Redis for caching and queues. DevOps: Dockerized services, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Linux servers behind Nginx, and deployments on Vercel.

I don't just build components — I architect complete solutions, from the database schema to the deployed application. Fluent in English, French, and Arabic, I communicate clearly with European and international clients. Independent, persistent, and passionate about turning ideas into production-ready web applications. Let's build something great together.

projectItems.title: Architectural Association Management Platform
projectItems.description: A full-featured management platform for a national architectural association handling 1000+ members. Automates member validation, financial tracking, penalty calculations, and dynamic PDF document generation with customizable templates and QR codes for official receipts, financial statements, and diplomas.

projectItems.title: E-commerce App
projectItems.description: A sleek, responsive e-commerce website built with React and Tailwind CSS, featuring category-based browsing, detailed product pages, and smooth UI interactions, designed with a minimalist palette.

projectItems.title: Multilingual Portfolio
projectItems.description: This portfolio: built with React and Tailwind CSS, featuring dark mode that follows your system, remembered preferences, responsive design, and reactive English/French support. Deployed on Vercel.

projectItems.title: Landing Page
